draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.weaknessQuote: Missed extensive time in 2017 and 2018 due to injuries.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.36, the 37th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 2nd of 21 at S. He went 45th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: T.J. Ward. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2019) ranked 3rd in tackles among the 21 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. 85 career games and 85 starts over 6 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 9 AV in 2025 against a career-best 15 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: season snap share 99.4% (97th percentile), approximate value 9 (95th percentile), missed tackle rate 4.1% (92nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 safety who played: 99.4% season snap share against a median of 64.8%, above the norm.
